title: SVTR AI Venture Database
description: Curated & traceable AI venture data: verified funding events, org & founder profiles, US + China
summary: Curated & traceable AI venture data: verified funding events, org & founder profiles, US + China
offersHint: Curated & traceable AI venture data: verified funding events, org & founder profiles, US + China · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://svtr.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_organizations
toolsPreview.description: 搜索 SVTR AI 创投库的公司与投资机构（按名称/别名，如 "Anthropic"、"a16z"）。Search AI companies and investors in the SVTR AI venture database by name or alias.

toolsPreview.name: get_organization_profile
toolsPreview.description: 按名称或 slug 取一家公司/投资机构的公开档案：简介、赛道、总部、累计融资、近期融资史（含来源链接）、投资机构的代表出手。Get the public profile of one organization: intro, sector, HQ, total funding, recent funding rounds with sources.

toolsPreview.name: get_person_profile
toolsPreview.description: 按姓名或 slug 取一位创始人/投资人的公开档案：现任机构与职务、工作经历、教育背景。Get the public profile of one founder or investor: current roles, work experience, education.

toolsPreview.name: get_recent_funding_events
toolsPreview.description: 最近 7 天的已核实 AI 融资事件（公开档位时间窗），可按赛道/阶段/公司名等单一维度筛选。Verified AI funding events from the last 7 days (public-tier window), filterable by one dimension.

toolsPreview.name: get_sector_landscape
toolsPreview.description: AI 赛道融资景观聚合统计：总额/笔数/中位数，全库赛道 Top10 或单赛道的阶段分布。仅聚合数字，无行级数据。Aggregated funding landscape: totals, top sectors, or stage breakdown for one sector.

toolsPreview.name: search_svtr_articles
toolsPreview.description: 搜索 SVTR 原创研究文章（Thesis 投资论文 / Profile 创始人深度 / Radar 事件判断 / 周报等，已发布口径）。Search SVTR original research articles.

toolsPreview.name: get_svtr_stats
toolsPreview.description: SVTR AI 创投库对外统计：已收录 AI 公司数、投资机构数、人物数、已核实融资轮数、原创文章数。Public counts of the SVTR AI venture database.
